title: 第1章 傻人有傻福第2章 喝多了好办事
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
侧躺的爸
抬腿的妈
装睡的孩子
幸福的一家
……
睡在炕上的李大炮被吵醒了，只见他睁开双眼，表情看起来憨憨的，有些傻里傻气。
“地震了吗？”
“炕要塌了吗？”
李大炮感觉炕在晃动，他一脸懵逼，转过头去，随后瞪大了眼睛。
隔壁，李大牛和王桂芬正折腾着要个儿子。
他们已经有了4个女儿，但是却没有儿子。
农村人的执念，没有皇位继承，也要有个带把的儿子。
李大牛很瘦，骨瘦嶙峋。
王桂芬却身材丰腴，而且身子很白。
因此李大炮一眼看过去，李大牛的身子，完全遮不住身材丰腴的王桂芬，大半个白皙的大腚，全都落入了他的眼中。
“大牛，你这名字真是白取了，一点都不牛。”
“你知道村里的人怎么说我的，说我生不出带把的小子。”
王桂芬委屈巴巴的说道，她只感觉腿都抬酸了，但是李大牛依然不给力。
李大牛已经忙得大汗淋漓，最后无奈的放弃，找了个蹩脚的理由：“都怪大炮，把炕烧太热了，影响到我发挥。”
“上次你说炕烧太冷了。”

“上上次你说饭没吃饱。”
“还有上上上次，你说肚子疼。”
……
王桂芬立即发飙，嫁给这么一个不中用的男人，她感觉受了一肚子的气。
“你这娘们，有完没完了，信不信我吃几个小蓝片，跟你拼了。”
李大牛火了，他可是个老爷们，要面子。
“你来啊，怕你不成。”
王桂芬啐道，说完又抬起了腿，一副挑衅的样子。
“今天算了，我没有准备，下次赶集我去买一盒回来。”李大牛心虚的说道。
“就知道吹牛，不管怎么样，今天你必须得好好表现，不然我就找大炮。”王桂芬没好气的说道。
“找大炮？他就一个傻子，他能行吗？”
李大牛开口嘲讽，他转过身去看了一眼，随后一阵懵逼，立即感觉到浓浓的自卑。
“哇！”
王桂芬却是双眼放光，惊讶地捂着嘴巴，连忙坐了起来。
李大炮这个名字只是他的外号，他的真名并不叫李大炮。
村里的人之所以给他起这个外号，自然是有原因的。
李大牛急眼了，随后一脚踹在李大炮的身上。
“怎么了？发生什么事了？”
李大炮装作刚刚醒的样子，他坐了起来，目光落在王桂芬的身上，完全移不开眼睛。
因为王桂芬还没穿衣服，这白皙丰腴的身子，在他的眼中极具吸引力。

“桂芬，赶紧把衣服穿上。”李大牛喝道。
“有什么好穿的，大炮就是个傻子，你还怕被他给占便宜了？”
王桂芬笑道，看着李大炮强壮的身子，不得不芳心颤抖。
这里是老母猪沟，牛犊子村，李大炮早年被人打成傻子，送回村子。
他又是个孤儿，无人照料，村里的女人们看着他可怜，就经常把他喊回家干活，顺便给他一口吃的。
content_en:
Dad lying on his side
Mom, lift your legs
child pretending to sleep
happy family
…
Li Dapao, who was sleeping on the kang, was woken up. He opened his eyes, his expression looked innocent and a little silly.
"Is there an earthquake?"
"Is the kang going to collapse?"
Li Dapao felt the kang shaking. He looked confused, turned his head, and then his eyes widened.
Next door, Li Daniu and Wang Guifen were trying to have a son.
They already have four daughters, but no sons.
The obsession of rural people is to have a son who can take charge of the throne even if there is no succession to the throne.
Li Daniu is very thin and bony.
Wang Guifen is plump and fair.
Therefore, Li Dapao took a quick look and saw that Li Daniu's body could not cover the plump Wang Guifen at all, and most of his fair buttocks fell into his eyes.
"Daniu, you got this name for nothing, you are not awesome at all."
"You know what the people in the village say about me, saying that I can't give birth to a boy with a handle."
Wang Guifen said aggrievedly. She felt her legs were sore from lifting, but Li Daniu still couldn't do anything.
Li Daniu was so busy that he was sweating profusely, and finally gave up helplessly, finding a lame excuse: "It's all Cannon's fault. The kang was too hot, which affected my performance."
"Last time you said the kang was too cold."
"Last time you said you didn't have enough food."
"And last time, you said you had a stomachache."
…
Wang Guifen immediately went into a rage. She felt very angry for marrying such a useless man.
"You bitch, you're not done yet. Believe it or not, I'll eat a few little blue slices and I'll give you a fight."
Li Daniu is popular. He is a gentleman and wants to save face.
"Come here, I'm afraid you won't make it."
Wang Guifen spat, and then raised her leg again, looking provocative.
"Forget it today, I'm not prepared. I'll buy a box next time I go to the market." Li Daniu said guiltily.
"I just know how to brag. No matter what, you must perform well today, otherwise I will find a cannon." Wang Guifen said angrily.
"Looking for a cannon? He's just a fool. Can he do it?"
Li Daniu taunted, he turned around and took a look, then felt confused and immediately felt a deep sense of inferiority.
"Wow!"
Wang Guifen's eyes shone, she covered her mouth in surprise, and sat up quickly.
The name Li Dapao is just his nickname, his real name is not Li Dapao.
There is naturally a reason why the people in the village gave him this nickname.
Li Daniu became anxious, and then kicked Li Dapao.
"What's wrong? What happened?"
Li Dapao pretended to have just woken up. He sat up and his eyes fell on Wang Guifen, unable to take his eyes away at all.
Because Wang Guifen had not yet put on any clothes, her fair and plump body was extremely attractive in his eyes.
"Guifen, put on your clothes quickly." Li Daniu shouted.
"What's there to wear? Cannon is just a fool. Are you afraid that he will take advantage of you?"
Wang Guifen smiled, looking at Li Dapao's strong body, her heart couldn't help but tremble.
This is Laosougou and Niuduzi Village. Li Dapao was beaten into a fool and sent back to the village in his early years.
He was an orphan and had no one to take care of him. The women in the village looked at him pitifully, so they often called him home to work and gave him a bite to eat.
